subject: sst
prompt_en: Why should new infrastructure be sustainable? Give two examples of greener infrastructure.
prompt_hi: Naya infrastructure tikau (sustainable) kyun hona chahiye? Hare-bhare infrastructure ke do example do.
answer: Because infrastructure lasts for decades, it should not harm the environment or use up resources future generations need. Examples: solar and wind power plants, metro rail and electric buses that cut pollution, rainwater harvesting, energy-efficient buildings, cycle lanes.

subject: sst
prompt_en: What does a bank do with the money people deposit?
prompt_hi: Bank logon ke jama kiye paise ke saath kya karta hai?
answer: It keeps part of the money as a reserve so depositors can withdraw when they need, and lends the rest to people and businesses who need loans, charging them interest.

subject: sst
prompt_en: How does a bank earn money?
answer: It charges borrowers a higher interest rate on loans than it pays depositors on savings; the difference (plus fees for some services) pays its costs and makes a profit.

subject: sst
prompt_en: What is the Reserve Bank of India, and what is one of its jobs?
prompt_hi: Reserve Bank of India kya hai, aur uska ek kaam kya hai?
answer: India's central bank, set up in 1935; it issues currency notes, regulates and supervises banks (it is the "banker's bank") and manages the country's money supply.

subject: sst
prompt_en: Compare a savings account with a fixed deposit.
prompt_hi: Savings account aur fixed deposit ki tulna karo.
answer: Savings account: you can deposit and withdraw any time; lower interest. Fixed deposit: money is locked for a fixed period (e.g. 1 year); higher interest; breaking it early may mean a penalty or lower interest.

subject: sst
prompt_en: Find the simple interest on ₹1,000 at 5% per year for 2 years. How much will you have in all?
prompt_hi: ₹1,000 par 5% saalana dar se 2 saal ka saadharan byaaj nikaalo. Kul kitne paise honge?

subject: sst
prompt_en: A shopkeeper borrows ₹20,000 at 10% per year simple interest for 3 years. How much interest will he pay, and how much in total?
prompt_hi: Ek dukaandaar ₹20,000 ka loan 10% saalana saadharan byaaj par 3 saal ke liye leta hai. Woh kitna byaaj dega, aur kul kitna lautaayega?

subject: sst
prompt_en: Find the mistake: "Aman deposits ₹2,000 at 6% per year for 1 year, so he will get back ₹2,006."
prompt_hi: Galti pakdo: "Aman ₹2,000 ko 6% saalana byaaj par 1 saal ke liye jama karta hai, isliye use ₹2,006 wapas milenge."

subject: sst
prompt_en: A bank raises its fixed-deposit rate from 6% to 8% per year. Predict how the interest on ₹10,000 for 1 year changes, and how savers might react.
prompt_hi: Ek bank fixed deposit ki dar 6% se badhaa kar 8% saalana kar deta hai. Socho ₹10,000 par 1 saal ka byaaj kaise badlega, aur bachat karne waale kya karenge.
answer: Interest rises from ₹600 to ₹800 a year; because saving now earns more, more people may choose to save or put money in fixed deposits.

subject: sst
prompt_en: A passbook shows: 1 Jan – deposit ₹500; 1 Feb – deposit ₹300; 15 Feb – withdrawal ₹200; 31 Mar – interest credited ₹10. Describe what happened in words and give the final balance (starting from zero).
prompt_hi: Ek passbook mein hai: 1 Jan – ₹500 jama; 1 Feb – ₹300 jama; 15 Feb – ₹200 nikaale; 31 Mar – ₹10 byaaj juda. Shabdon mein batao kya hua aur aakhri balance batao (shuruaat zero se).
answer: The account holder deposited ₹500 in January and ₹300 in February, withdrew ₹200 in mid-February, and the bank added ₹10 interest at the end of March: 500 + 300 − 200 + 10 = ₹610.

subject: sst
prompt_en: Why was the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana started in 2014?
prompt_hi: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana 2014 mein kyun shuru ki gayi?
answer: To bring banking to everyone, especially poor and rural families who had no bank account: it offered zero-balance accounts, a RuPay debit card and insurance cover, let government benefits be paid directly into accounts, and reduced dependence on moneylenders.

subject: sst
prompt_en: Compare borrowing from a village moneylender with borrowing from a bank or a self-help group.
prompt_hi: Gaon ke saahookaar se udhaar lene aur bank ya self-help group se loan lene ki tulna karo.
answer: Moneylender: quick and informal, but often very high interest, no written rules, and borrowers can fall into a debt trap. Bank or self-help group: needs some paperwork or group membership, but lower, regulated interest, clear written terms and protection under rules; SHGs also build savings and support among members.

subject: sst
prompt_en: You want to buy a ₹1,200 cycle in one year. Make a saving plan: how much must you save each month, and why might a recurring deposit in a bank be better than a piggy bank?
prompt_hi: Tum ek saal mein ₹1,200 ki cycle khareedna chahte ho. Bachat ki yojana banao: har mahine kitna bachaana hoga, aur bank ka recurring deposit gullak se behtar kyun ho sakta hai?
answer: Save ₹100 every month for 12 months (1,200 ÷ 12 = 100). A recurring deposit keeps the money safe, makes you save regularly, and earns a little interest, while a piggy bank earns nothing and is easy to break open early.

subject: sst
prompt_en: Give three rules for banking safely.
answer: Never share your PIN, OTP or password with anyone, even someone claiming to be from the bank (banks never ask for them); check SMS alerts and report unknown transactions at once; block a lost card immediately; do not click unknown links or install apps on a caller's request.

subject: sst
prompt_en: Teach a friend the "magic of finance": how one family's savings in a bank can help another family start a shop, and who earns what.
prompt_hi: Dost ko "finance ka jaadu" samjhao: ek parivaar ki bank mein bachat doosre parivaar ki dukaan kholne mein kaise madad karti hai, aur kaun kya kamaata hai.
answer: Key idea: Family A deposits savings; the bank keeps some as reserve and lends the rest to Family B to start a shop; Family B repays the loan with interest from the shop's earnings; the bank pays Family A interest (lower than what B pays) and keeps the difference for its costs and profit — everyone gains and money keeps working.
